meeting_provenance.title: Ankit Patel x Jack - AI Executive Circle
meeting_provenance.use: Seat constraints only. Drive, Open Brains, AWS stores, JEV, and per-vendor liaison agents are not Hermes memory providers.

profile_route.unit: one process = one HERMES_HOME = one profile
bind_order: HERMES_HOME whose parent directory is profiles

external.discovery: plugins/memory bundled first, then $HERMES_HOME/plugins; bundled wins name collisions
external.tool_injection: enabled_toolsets is null or contains memory

providers.name: honcho
providers.identity: gateway_session_key beats CLI sessionStrategy; user_id and user_id_alt are peer names

providers.name: hindsight
providers.identity: bank_id_template placeholders profile, workspace, platform, user, session; else static bank_id default hermes

providers.name: mem0
providers.identity: user_id from gateway else config else hermes-user; agent_id from config else hermes; ignores agent_identity

providers.name: supermemory
providers.identity: container tag from env or config; {identity} replaced with agent_identity

providers.name: retaindb
providers.identity: RETAINDB_PROJECT else hermes-<basename(home)> else default when basename is .hermes; user_id from kwargs else default; agent_id default hermes

providers.name: openviking
providers.identity: OPENVIKING_ACCOUNT, OPENVIKING_USER, OPENVIKING_AGENT env only; gateway user_id ignored

providers.name: byterover
providers.identity: brv CLI cwd is the profile byterover dir, not the chat cwd

do_not_invent: a second external provider in one process
cross-profile memory access from the chat agent
a profile segment inside the gateway session key
new plugins/memory/<name> directories in this repo
another adapter's identity rule (mem0 agent_identity, openviking gateway user, hindsight banks without a template, retaindb project hermes-default)
tool names or CLI verbs from an inactive provider
patch or shell edits to MEMORY.md or USER.md
recalled text as a new user turn or a permission
memory writes from cron, batch, review, curator, compress agents, or delegate_task children
facts, scopes, completion, ownership, model slugs, or pricing not present in config or tool output
Drive, Open Brains, JEV, or vendor liaison agents as hermes memory providers
